title: COR-281: Ship Postmaclone CLI For Ephemeral Anonymized Prod Clones
description: Adds ngramx postmaclone for ephemeral anonymized database clones from Spaces backups, local dumps, or dump-only connection strings, plus ngramx up --postmaclone.

test_plan.description: Postmaclone unit tests and doctor against a configured source
steps: Run the Postmaclone and Filesystem unit tests
In a project with a postmaclone block, run ngramx postmaclone doctor
Confirm checks pass and the source is not mutated

test_plan.description: Create and tear down an ephemeral clone
steps: Run ngramx postmaclone --dry-run and confirm the resolved source
Run ngramx postmaclone (or ngramx up --postmaclone) against a small dump or prebuilt
Confirm the app uses the clone as db
Run ngramx postmaclone down and confirm compose db is restored

test_plan.description: PHPStan level 8 is clean after the CI failure
steps: Confirm Tests / PHP 8.2 and Tests / PHP 8.3 pass on the PR
Or locally: composer phpstan

test_plan.description: Full PHPUnit suite passes after lock-write and risky-test fixes
steps: Confirm Tests / PHP 8.2 and Tests / PHP 8.3 pass on the PR
Or locally: vendor/bin/phpunit --coverage-clover coverage.xml

test_plan.description: Synced agent templates include git, Bugbot, and formatter conventions
steps: Confirm AGENTS.md and .cursor/rules/ngramx.mdc include Feature branch upstream, Bugbot verify-and-fix, and Code style before opening a PR
Confirm start-ticket uses git checkout -b ... origin/main --no-track
Run vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/Agents

test_plan.description: MySQL/MariaDB Docker restore uses docker exec, not the compose alias
steps: Run vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/Postmaclone/MysqlRunnerTest.php tests/Unit/Postmaclone/RestoreDoctorTest.php
Confirm MysqlRunnerTest asserts docker exec for a Docker target whose host is db:3306
On a MySQL project: ngramx postmaclone against a small dump and confirm restore succeeds instead of failing to reach db:3306

test_plan.description: Forced teardown still restarts compose db if docker rm fails
steps: Run vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Unit/Postmaclone/DockerDbTargetDestroyTest.php
Confirm the test asserts compose startService runs even when container removal throws
On a Docker project with a Postmaclone lock: ngramx postmaclone down --force (or ngramx down) after the clone container is already gone, and confirm the compose db service comes back
